title: 奈飞主管当场否认：没有一部剧是给所有人看，全球最大付费平台为何反着说
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I want to start talking about the programming on Netflix.
segments.zh: 我想先聊聊Netflix的节目内容。

segments.en: You're the biggest video streaming service out. We'll take the YouTube out of the equation for that.
segments.zh: 你们是最大的视频流媒体服务。这里先不算YouTube。

segments.en: The biggest paid video streaming service in the world. And you talk a lot about kind of making these big broad shows that kind of appeal to a lot of viewers.
segments.zh: 全球最大的付费视频流媒体服务。你经常提到制作这些能吸引大量观众的大众化节目。

segments.en: And I think some people feel like, as you have targeted more and more people, that your shows are suddenly not because they're for everyone, they're kind of for no one.
segments.zh: 我觉得有些人觉得，随着你们越来越针对更多人群，你们的节目突然变得不是为所有人，而是有点谁都不讨好。

segments.en: And so I'm wondering, what do you think distinguishes Netflix's programming from your peers?
segments.zh: 所以我想知道，你认为Netflix的节目与同行相比有什么独特之处？

segments.en: Well, first of all, just to kind of set that record straight, we do nothing we make on Netflix's for everyone.
segments.zh: 首先，澄清一下，我们在Netflix上制作的内容没有一个是给所有人看的。

segments.en: We hope you find your favorite show on Netflix for sure.
segments.zh: 我们当然希望你能在Netflix上找到你最喜欢的节目。

segments.en: To do that, people's tastes are crazy diverse.
segments.zh: 要做到这一点，人们的品味极其多样。

segments.en: My wife and I don't agree on what to watch. So it's pretty hard to get the whole world to agree on what to watch.
segments.zh: 我和我妻子对看什么意见都不一致。所以要让全世界对看什么达成一致相当难。

segments.en: So you make a lot of things that appeal to different tastes, including more prestige, awards-y kinds of programming,
segments.zh: 所以你们制作了很多迎合不同品味的内容，包括更有声望、获奖类的节目，

segments.en: for that audience, which was by the way, when we started, that's all we did.
segments.zh: 对那类观众而言，顺便说一句，我们起步时只做这个。

segments.en: So to give it kind of an idea of how the programming initiative was broadened over the years, that day when we started with House of Cards in February of 2013,
segments.zh: 所以大致说明一下节目规划这些年如何拓宽，2013年2月我们推出《纸牌屋》那天，

segments.en: we had one kind of thing, just prestige, serialized drama.
segments.zh: 我们只有一种类型，就是高端连续剧。

segments.en: And then we've since then we've added competition shows and game shows and cooking shows and travel shows and original movies and standard comedy.
segments.zh: 之后我们陆续增加了竞技秀、游戏秀、烹饪秀、旅行秀、原创电影和标准喜剧。

segments.en: Everything we've done since then has just been an ongoing expansion.
segments.zh: 此后我们所做的一切都只是持续扩张。
